have hX_meas : Measurable (fun ω => X ω) := AEMeasurable.measurable hXmeas
let f := fun ω => 1 - X ω
have hf_meas : Measurable f := measurable_const.mul_left measurable_id hf_meas
have hf_ae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω = 1 - X ω := by aesop
have hf_eq : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω = 1 - X ω := by aesop
have hf_zero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, f ω = 0 ∨ f ω = 1 :=
  by { intros ω, rw [hf_eq, hX], cases (hX ω) with a b, refine or.inl (by simp), refine or.inr (by simp) }
have hf_support : μ.real {ω | f ω = 1} = μ.real {ω | X ω = 0} :=
  by { rw [hf_eq, hX], congr, apply measure_congr, intro ω, split; intro h; exact h }
have hf_integral : ∫ (ω : Ω), f ω ∂μ = μ.real {ω | f ω = 1} :=
  by { rw [hf_support], apply integral_indicator, exact hf_meas, exact hf_zero }
rw [hf_integral, hf_support]
